answer_2.quote: We adopt the TrueSkill™ ratings as the evaluation metrics... In all environments except Undercover, we conducted LLMARENA runs until the TrueSkill™ ratings between models reached convergence... Reward ... allows for a quantitative and interpretable evaluation of LLMs' capabilities...

answer_4.quote: We conduct an extensive experiment and human evaluation among 14 different sizes and types of LLMs.
